components.note: The composite row (original note: 'currently left to an exercise') is supplied as a stated theorem marked proved=annex:p2.fol.clausal.composition (no longer a cited-only declaration) with a written composed proof in the annex, and each listed subcomponent GOAL-01..03 is covered below. Hypotheses kept: nonempty-domain semantics (SUP 4-5; SEM 11), location of AC (SUP 119-121), sentence input with an explicit closure caveat for open formulas (SUP 237-239).

The declared input is a first-order L-sentence (SUP 117). The pipeline NNF -> rectified NNF -> prenex NNF -> universal Skolem sentence -> CNF matrix -> clause set is stated in the theorem by reference to the table's CNF branch (DNF row 6 flagged as comparison only), drawn in the figure, and worked in the example, including the bottom / not-bottom empty cases. Observation, not a gap: the annex carries out table steps 5 and 7 together as S = Cl(theta), the clause-family form of distributive CNF proved pointwise in thm:p02-matrix-clause-equivalence.

The annex writes the composition: prenex via thm:prenex-normal-form and lem:fol-nnf with no new nonlogical symbol (ANX 110-119); Skolemization via thm:skolem-equisatisfiable into L* with one fresh function symbol per existential position, arity zero for an initial existential (ANX 121-129); then S = Cl(theta) in the same L* (ANX 135-140). Freshness and signature changes are explicit: rectified binders lie outside the forbidden set V (R 109-111; table row 2); a new Skolem symbol per existential occurrence (R 292, 299-301; table row 4); Cl introduces no variable or symbol (SUP 97-98, 112); the expansion L* is finite (SUP 118; ANX 125).

Directions are stated correctly and formula equivalence is not asserted across Skolemization: model -> expansion under AC, S-model -> reduct without choice (SUP 119-121; R 320-328; ANX 130-133, 168-171); only the Skolem step weakens same-signature equivalence (SUP 123-124; table row 4; figure caption; R 432-435; ANX 173-174); the matrix-to-clause step is equivalence in the same expanded signature (ANX 139-140) and the clause-set reading goes through universal closures, not formula-string equivalence (SUP 205-206, 215-216). Expansion and reduct are defined at SEM 22-40 and reduct invariance is lem:reduct-invariance at RED 69-81.
